subject: Substiution of geom_segment for geom_rect does not work

messages.author: 4bd1e087b45f3e85
messages.subject: Substiution of geom_segment for geom_rect does not work
parts:
Hello,

I have a question concerning geom_rect (that works not how I expect) and geom_segment (that works but I dont want it because ... it is geom_segment - I dont want diagonal lines. I want "rectangles").

segment-syntax:
> ggplot (df) + facet_grid (type~., scales="free_y")+ geom_point(aes(x=start.ens, y=fc.trans)) + geom_segment(aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.ens, y=0, yend=peak))+ geom_segment(aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.grcm38, y=0, yend=dpeak))

It is the same for a less complex syntax without facet_grid etc.:
> ggplot (df) + geom_segment(aes (x=start.ens, xend=end.grcm38, y=0, yend=dpeak))


rect-syntax:
ggplot (df) + facet_grid (type~., scales="free_y")+ geom_point(aes(x=start.ens, y=fc.trans)) + geom_rect(aes (xmin=start.ens, xmax=end.ens, ymin=0, ymax=peak))+ geom_rect(aes (xmin=start.ens, xmax=end.grcm38, ymin=0, ymax=dpeak))

Same thing for rect-syntax:

>  ggplot (df) + geom_rect(aes (xmin=start.ens, xmax=end.grcm38, ymin=0, ymax=dpeak))

Principally (I thougt) it should be easy to substitute geom_segment for geom_rect. But it isnt the case. Where is the mistake?

Actually, I worked several times ( and then partially and then it did not work at all) but I cannot reproduce it.

Thanks
Hermann
